newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Bank Danamon seeks approvals for deals.
newsitem.headline: Bank Danamon seeks approvals for deals.

text.p: Indonesian large privately-owned PT Bank Danamon Indonesia said on Wednesday it planned to hold an extraordinary shareholders meeting in late August to seek approvals for proposed transactions with subsidiaries.

Danamon said in an announcement that on July 25 the bank had signed memorandum of understandings with several subsidiaries to provide support services including property, advertising, telecommunications and transportation to the bank.
The bank said the deals would increase efficiency and maximise the firm's financial capibility in the face of rising competition in the banking sector.
